text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: `prod-runtime-high-p95` — threshold 300ms exceeded on region-us-west cluster-prod-3. Alert key: PD-8231

Maya Patel: Acked. I'm oncall. Spinning up console now.

pagerduty-bot: Notification escalated to policy 'oncall-primary' — paging Maya Patel.

Tom Nguyen: I can see a short spike in request queuing on prod-3 — queue_depth up from 40->320 over 30s. p95 jumps to ~730ms then falls.

Maya Patel: Thanks Tom. Any customer-facing errors? I don't see 5xx increase in SLO metrics in the last 5m, mostly latency.

Sasha Ivanov: Logs show a burst of `kv_cache_miss` and repeated `GPU_batch_full` backpressure on a few pods. Extract:```
[2026-03-14T12:13:08Z] pod/runtime-3a: kv_cache_miss=true batch_size=64 queue_len=289
[2026-03-14T12:13:09Z] pod/runtime-3b: GPU_batch_full=true pending=12
[2026-03-14T12:13:10Z] pod/runtime-3a: p95=712ms tokens=120
```

Leo Chen: Autoscaler didn't kick in for those nodes because pod eviction threshold hit earlier today (we dropped scale buffer to 10%). Might be correlation.

Maya Patel: Okay, mitigation plan: 1) temporarily bump scale_buffer to 30% for prod-3, 2) route a small % of traffic away from prod-3 to prod-1, prod-2, 3) keep an eye for 10m.

Tom Nguyen: I'll open a weighted-routing change now. Will shift 15% off prod-3.

Tom Nguyen: Done. Route change applied: `traffic-shift --from prod-3 --to prod-1,prod-2 --weight 15%`.

Maya Patel: Increasing scale buffer on prod-3 via infra-runbook:```
infractl set autoscaler --cluster prod-3 --scale-buffer 30
```

Sasha Ivanov: Running a quick health sweep on affected pods, tail logs look noisy but no OOMs. There's a retry storm from a small client (svc-logger) flooding with short prompts.

Maya Patel: Can we throttle svc-logger at the gateway? If it's causing excessive tiny requests it could blow up batching efficiency.

Leo Chen: I put a short rate-limit rule: `ratelimit svc-logger 10r/s` on edge for 5m.

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-8231: acknowledged by Maya Patel.

Tom Nguyen: After routing + throttle, p95 dropped back under 310ms in the next 40s and queue_len stabilized <60.

Maya Patel: Good. I'm going to leave autoscaler buffer at 30% for 15 minutes then revert if stable. Keeping the thread open for 20m observation window.

Sasha Ivanov: Confirmed no customer-facing errors and no increased error rates in downstream services. Looks limited to batch/queue inefficiency.

pagerduty-bot: PD-8231 automatically resolved (no further firing) — reason: alert condition cleared.

Maya Patel: Thanks all — looks like a transient noisy client + tight scale buffer caused a short latency spike. Action items: (1) Follow-up with platform to evaluate default scale_buffer (2) Contact svc-logger owners to reduce tiny prompt fanout (3) Add an autoscaler alert to detect low buffer headroom. I'll file a short post-incident note.

Tom Nguyen: +1 on post-incident. I'll paste the routing diff into the ticket.

Sasha Ivanov: i'll pull sample traces and attach.

Maya Patel: Closing thread for now, will reopen if it recurs. :white_check_mark:
